x: The veil. He screens himself in the ancient light, garrisons himself in the fortress, and asks that the eyes of the wrongdoers be dimmed toward him — closing on the same verses of sufficiency that seal the Ḥizb al-Baḥr.
بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ
Bismi llāhi r-Raḥmāni r-Raḥīm.
In the name of Allāh, the All-Merciful, the Ever-Merciful.

اِحْتَجَبْتُ بِنُورِ اللهِ الْقَدِيمِ الْكَامِلِ، وَتَحَصَّنْتُ بِحِصْنِ اللهِ الْقَوِيِّ الشَّامِلِ، وَرَمَيْتُ مَنْ بَغَى عَلَيَّ بِسَهْمِ اللهِ وَسَيْفِهِ الْقَاتِلِ. اللَّهُمَّ يَا غَالِبًا عَلَى أَمْرِهِ، وَيَا قَائِمًا فَوْقَ خَلْقِهِ، وَيَا حَائِلًا بَيْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَقَلْبِهِ، احُلْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ الشَّيْطَانِ وَنَزْغِهِ، وَبَيْنَ مَنْ لَا طَاقَةَ لِي بِهِ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ أَجْمَعِينَ.

Iḥtajabtu bi-nūri llāhi l-qadīmi l-kāmil, wa-taḥaṣṣantu bi-ḥiṣni llāhi l-qawiyyi sh-shāmil, wa-ramaytu man baghā ʿalayya bi-sahmi llāhi wa-sayfihi l-qātil. Allāhumma yā Ghāliban ʿalā amrih, wa-yā Qāʾiman fawqa khalqih, wa-yā Ḥāʾilan bayna l-marʾi wa-qalbih: ḥul baynī wa-bayna sh-shayṭāni wa-nazghih, wa-bayna man lā ṭāqata lī bihi min khalqika ajmaʿīn.

I have veiled myself in the ancient and perfect light of Allāh; I have fortified myself in the strong and all-encompassing fortress of Allāh; and I have struck whoever transgresses against me with the arrow of Allāh and His slaying sword. O Allāh — O You who prevail over Your affair, O You who stand above Your creation, O You who come between a man and his heart — come between me and Satan and his goading, and between me and any of Your creation whom I have no strength to withstand.

اللَّهُمَّ كُفَّ عَنِّي أَلْسِنَةَ أَعْدَائِي، وَاغْلُلْ أَيْدِيَهُمْ وَأَرْجُلَهُمْ، وَارْبِطْ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ، وَاجْعَلْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّا مِنْ نُورِ عَظَمَتِكَ، وَحِجَابًا مِنْ قُوَّتِكَ، وَجُنْدًا مِنْ سُلْطَانِكَ، إِنَّكَ حَيٌّ قَادِرٌ مُقْتَدِرٌ قَهَّارٌ.

Allāhumma kuffa ʿannī alsinata aʿdāʾī, wa-ghlul aydiyahum wa-arjulahum, wa-rbiṭ ʿalā qulūbihim, wa-jʿal baynī wa-baynahum saddan min nūri ʿaẓamatika, wa-ḥijāban min quwwatika, wa-jundan min sulṭānika; innaka Ḥayyun Qādirun Muqtadirun Qahhār.

O Allāh, restrain from me the tongues of my enemies; shackle their hands and their feet; bind up their hearts; and set between me and them a wall from the light of Your magnificence, a veil from Your strength, and an army from Your sovereignty. You are Living, Able, All-Powerful, Overwhelming.
اللَّهُمَّ أَعْشِ عَنِّي أَبْصَارَ الْأَشْرَارِ وَالظَّلَمَةِ، حَتَّى لَا أُبَالِيَ بِأَبْصَارِهِمْ.
Allāhumma aʿshi ʿannī abṣāra l-ashrāri wa-ẓ-ẓalamah, ḥattā lā ubāliya bi-abṣārihim.
O Allāh, dim toward me the eyes of the wicked and the oppressors, so that I need not care for their looking.
﴿ يَكَادُ سَنَا بَرْقِهِ يَذْهَبُ بِالْأَبْصَارِ ۝ يُقَلِّبُ اللَّهُ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِأُولِي الْأَبْصَارِ ﴾
Yakādu sanā barqihi yadhhabu bi-l-abṣār. Yuqallibu llāhu l-layla wa-n-nahār; inna fī dhālika la-ʿibratan li-ulī l-abṣār.
The flash of His lightning all but takes away the sight. Allāh turns about the night and the day; surely in that is a lesson for those who have eyes to see.
بِسْمِ اللهِ كهيعص، بِسْمِ اللهِ حم عسق.
Bismi llāhi Kāf Hāʾ Yāʾ ʿAyn Ṣād; bismi llāhi Ḥāʾ Mīm ʿAyn Sīn Qāf.
In the name of Allāh: Kāf Hāʾ Yāʾ ʿAyn Ṣād. In the name of Allāh: Ḥāʾ Mīm · ʿAyn Sīn Qāf.
﴿ كَمَاءٍ أَنْزَلْنَاهُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَاخْتَلَطَ بِهِ نَبَاتُ الْأَرْضِ فَأَصْبَحَ هَشِيمًا تَذْرُوهُ الرِّيَاحُ ﴾ .
Ka-māʾin anzalnāhu mina s-samāʾi fa-khtalaṭa bihi nabātu l-arḍi fa-aṣbaḥa hashīman tadhrūhu r-riyāḥ.
Like water We send down from the sky, so that the plants of the earth mingle with it, and then it becomes dry stubble which the winds scatter.
﴿ هُوَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ هُوَ الرَّحْمَٰنُ الرَّحِيمُ ﴾ .
Huwa llāhu lladhī lā ilāha illā huwa, ʿālimu l-ghaybi wa-sh-shahādah; huwa r-Raḥmānu r-Raḥīm.
He is Allāh, other than whom there is no god: Knower of the unseen and the seen. He is the All-Merciful, the Ever-Merciful.
﴿ يَوْمَ الْآزِفَةِ إِذِ الْقُلُوبُ لَدَى الْحَنَاجِرِ كَاظِمِينَ مَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ حَمِيمٍ وَلَا شَفِيعٍ يُطَاعُ ﴾ .
Yawma l-āzifati idhi l-qulūbu ladā l-ḥanājiri kāẓimīn; mā li-ẓ-ẓālimīna min ḥamīmin wa-lā shafīʿin yuṭāʿ.
The Day of the Approaching, when hearts are at the throats, choking. The wrongdoers will have no devoted friend and no intercessor to be obeyed.
﴿ عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَا أَحْضَرَتْ ۝ فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِالْخُنَّسِ ۝ الْجَوَارِ الْكُنَّسِ ۝ وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ ۝ وَالصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ ۝ إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ ﴾ .
ʿAlimat nafsun mā aḥḍarat. Fa-lā uqsimu bi-l-khunnas. Al-jawāri l-kunnas. Wa-l-layli idhā ʿasʿas. Wa-ṣ-ṣubḥi idhā tanaffas. Innahu la-qawlu rasūlin karīm.

Every soul shall know what it has brought forward. I swear by the receding stars — the running, the setting; and by the night as it darkens; and by the dawn as it breathes: truly this is the word of a noble messenger.
﴿ ص ۚ وَالْقُرْآنِ ذِي الذِّكْرِ ۝ بَلِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فِي عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ ﴾ .
Ṣād. Wa-l-Qurʾāni dhī dh-dhikr. Bali lladhīna kafarū fī ʿizzatin wa-shiqāq.
Ṣād. By the Qurʾān, holder of the Remembrance. Rather, those who disbelieve are in arrogance and schism.
﴿ شَاهَتِ الْوُجُوهُ ﴾ (٣)،
Shāhati l-wujūh (×3).
Disfigured be the faces. (Three times.)

وَعَمِيَتِ الْأَبْصَارُ، وَكَلَّتِ الْأَلْسُنُ، جَعَلْتُ خَيْرَهُمْ بَيْنَ أَعْيُنِهِمْ، وَشَرَّهُمْ تَحْتَ أَقْدَامِهِمْ، وَخَاتَمَ سُلَيْمَانَ بَيْنَ أَكْتَافِهِمْ، لَا يَسْمَعُونَ وَلَا يُبْصِرُونَ وَلَا يَنْطِقُونَ، بِحَقِّ كهيعص.

Wa-ʿamiyati l-abṣār, wa-kallati l-alsun; jaʿaltu khayrahum bayna aʿyunihim, wa-sharrahum taḥta aqdāmihim, wa-khātama Sulaymāna bayna aktāfihim; lā yasmaʿūna wa-lā yubṣirūna wa-lā yanṭiqūn, bi-ḥaqqi Kāf Hāʾ Yāʾ ʿAyn Ṣād.

And blinded be the eyes, and dulled the tongues. I have set their good before their eyes, and their evil beneath their feet, and the seal of Sulaymān between their shoulders: they neither hear, nor see, nor speak — by the right of Kāf Hāʾ Yāʾ ʿAyn Ṣād.
﴿ فَسَيَكْفِيكَهُمُ اللَّهُ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ ﴾ (٣).
Fa-sayakfīkahumu llāhu wa-huwa s-Samīʿu l-ʿAlīm (×3).
Allāh will suffice you against them; and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing. (Three times.)
﴿ إِنَّ وَلِيِّيَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي نَزَّلَ الْكِتَابَ وَهُوَ يَتَوَلَّى الصَّالِحِينَ ﴾ (٣).
Inna waliyyiya llāhu lladhī nazzala l-kitāb, wa-huwa yatawallā ṣ-ṣāliḥīn (×3).
My protector is Allāh, who sent down the Book; and He takes the righteous into His protection. (Three times.)
﴿ حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ ﴾ (٧).
Ḥasbiya llāhu lā ilāha illā huwa; ʿalayhi tawakkaltu wa-huwa Rabbu l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīm (×7).
Allāh is sufficient for me; there is no god but He. In Him I place my trust, and He is Lord of the Mighty Throne. (Seven times.)
﴿ بَلْ هُوَ قُرْآنٌ مَجِيدٌ ۝ فِي لَوْحٍ مَحْفُوظٍ ﴾ .
Bal huwa Qurʾānun majīd, fī lawḥin maḥfūẓ.
Rather, it is a glorious Qurʾān, upon a Preserved Tablet.

اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ فَوْقِي وَمِنْ تَحْتِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَمِنْ أَمَامِي، وَمِنْ ظَاهِرِي وَمِنْ بَاطِنِي، وَمِنْ بَعْضِي وَمِنْ كُلِّي، وَحُلْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ مَا يَحُولُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكَ، يَا اللهُ (٣).

Allāhumma ḥfaẓnī min fawqī wa-min taḥtī, wa-ʿan yamīnī wa-ʿan shimālī, wa-min khalfī wa-min amāmī, wa-min ẓāhirī wa-min bāṭinī, wa-min baʿḍī wa-min kullī; wa-ḥul baynī wa-bayna mā yaḥūlu baynī wa-baynak, yā Allāh (×3).

O Allāh, guard me from above me and from below me, from my right and from my left, from behind me and from before me, from my outward and from my inward, from a part of me and from the whole of me. And come between me and whatever comes between me and You. O Allāh. (Three times.)
وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ.
Wa-lā ḥawla wa-lā quwwata illā bi-llāhi l-ʿAliyyi l-ʿAẓīm.
And there is no power and no strength save by Allāh, the Most High, the Magnificent.
وَصَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ الطَّيِّبِينَ الطَّاهِرِينَ وَصَحْبِهِ الْكِرَامِ الْبَرَرَةِ أَجْمَعِينَ، وَسَلَّمَ تَسْلِيمًا.
Wa-ṣallā llāhu ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ʿalā ālihi ṭ-ṭayyibīna ṭ-ṭāhirīn, wa-ṣaḥbihi l-kirāmi l-bararati ajmaʿīn, wa-sallama taslīmā.
And may Allāh bless our master Muḥammad, and his family, the good and the pure, and all his noble and righteous Companions, and grant them abundant peace.
Ḥizb al-Ikhfāʾ — 20 bands. Imām Abū al-Ḥasan al-Shādhilī, d. 656 AH / 1258 CE.
